title: hole
description: A monomorphism j : U ↪ H into a nucleus where the structure thins: the quasicrystalline structure of U is strictly less symmetric/lower-complexity than the host's restriction (H1), and every outgoing morphism from U factors uniquely through a boundary object ∂U (H2). A hole is the degenerate substructure through which one world is reached from another; pullback-stable. Not itself a world.

host.description: the nucleus H the hole sits inside

structural-degeneration.description: (H1) QC(U) is strictly less symmetric or lower-complexity than QC(H)|_U

boundary-factorization.description: (H2) every g : U → X factors uniquely as U → ∂U → X
